item.title: Cast! -Private Heroine-
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: BELL-DA
  • 発売日: 2001-08-02
  • スコア: なし (4 人評価)
  • 日本語名: CAST！-プライベートヒロイン-
  • 英語名: Cast! -Private Heroine-

あらすじ

Takumi Ogata enters Wakasagi-Gakuin, a school majoring in entertainment, to pursue his career as a writer. He meets three cute and aspiring actresses: The reliable and confident Akane, the shy and childish Saya, and the proud but gorgeous Mitsuru. Takumi decides to form a theatre with these unique and very talented girls.

They begin to prepare a play for the school festival, which will be held in October. Takumi falls in love with one of the girls as he writes and directs the play by himself. Unlike all those “get your favorite girl” games in the past, this is a game of love in progress, which means you have to develop the relationship between your favorite character and the hero. The new feature called “Story Edit Mode” lets the player choose the lines of the female characters in order to make your own storyline. The player also needs to take care of “night life” with the girls as well as daily conversations to get the best results!

  • 英語名: Magical★Treasure Kanojo wa Maid 2

あらすじ

Our guy became lord of a remote town inorder to find a cure for his childhood girl, a princess cursed into sleep at age 16 by a black dragon. He heard there are fairies around that town that can help him find a cure. This is a Simulation, Role Playing and Adventure game. Monday to Friday is Simluation part, where he manage his town and train himself. Saturday is the Role Playing part, where he go out with one of his fairy maids to explore and find items. Sunday, the Adventure part, he can take one of his fairies for a date or go meet other girls. Also on Sunday, he can mix and use his items collected on Saturday for fun.

あらすじ

A year after your graduation, you’ve become a security guard, and your first post happens to be at your old school, where you used to be the president of the student council.

But everything there seems off: the school is set to close, and everyone you knew seems depressed, or acts strange. Nothing like the flourishing school it was a year ago. And nobody will answer your questions about how this happened.
